job.job_description:
AI integration Engineer

Experience :1-2 Year | Job Type: Onsite, Full-time | Job Location: Infopark, Cochin

We are seeking a skilled AI Integration Engineer to design, develop, and integrate AI-driven solutions into existing applications and systems. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Node.js, exposure to Angular, and practical experience working with AI technologies to build scalable and intelligent solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and integrate AI/ML solutions into web and backend applications.
Build and maintain backend services using Node.js for AI-driven workflows and APIs.
Collaborate with frontend teams to integrate AI features into Angular applications.
Work with AI models, APIs, or services (e.g., NLP, chatbots, recommendation systems, automation tools).
Ensure smooth data flow between AI models, backend services, and frontend applications.
Optimize AI integrations for performance, scalability, and security.
Troubleshoot, debug, and enhance AI-enabled features across the application stack.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, QA, and DevOps.
Stay updated with emerging AI tools, frameworks, and best practices.
Required Skills Qualifications
Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with Node.js.
Experience working with Angular for frontend development or integration.
Practical experience working with AI technologies, AI APIs, or ML-based solutions.
Understanding of RESTful APIs and system integrations.
Familiarity with databases (SQL/NoSQL) and data handling for AI workflows.
Good problem-solving and analytical skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Preferred Skills (Good to Have)
Experience integrating third-party AI services or models.
Basic understanding of machine learning concepts.
Knowledge of cloud platforms and deployment practices.
Experience with automation, chatbots, or AI-driven analytics.
